Here I output the value of `str1` before the `.toLowercase()` method gets called:

issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
Can not sort at 'Last Msg' column on 'Player Logs' table

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Play game with data wargame-l6nngxlk
2. Click on icon 'Player log'
3. Click 'Sort' icon at 'Last Msg' column 
4.  Notice it direct to white screen

View below screencast for more detail

Note : Issue is also happened with 'Sent at' column
![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/6b129fc1-0c8f-4bd6-bcd3-e3c85f0409de)


## ⚙️ Expected behavior
Enable to sort for 'Last Msg' column and will not direct to white screen

## 🖥️ Screencasts

https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/f8fde8d8-54a9-4a62-b2a6-97e6f227983a

## 💻 System information
- Browser : Chrome
- Browser Version : Version 120.0.6099.111
